$comment: Part IV (Appendix A, Building & Object Catalogue) + Catalogue Supplement / Supplement 2 / Supplement 3 of docs/METROPOLIS-MASTER-v2.1.md, transcribed verbatim (unlock/cost/capacity/notes text) into structured entries. FEAT-010 / data.catalogue. Never edit the numeric literals here without updating the spec doc first (GR#15: this file IS the source of truth engine validators read, not a hardcoded Go constant). See docs/design/buildings-schema.md for the field reference and docs/planning/acceptance/data.catalogue.md for acceptance criteria. Every gap the spec itself left unfilled (flat comma-lists with no stated cost/unlock, one-row families split into tiers, interpolated middle tiers) is logged as a BOW ASM- assumption -- see the buildings loader's package doc for the list.
